dv: grams boneless chicken, cut into small pieces
/4 cup boiled potatoes, mashed or cubed
tablespoon lonumirus curry powder or chilly powder
teaspoon chicken stock powder or 1 Maggie cube
en: grams boneless chicken, cut into small pieces
/4 cup boiled potatoes, mashed or cubed
tablespoon lonumirus curry powder or chilly powder
teaspoon chicken stock powder or 1 Maggie cube

instructions.dv:
Making filling
Heat oil in a pan, add onion, ginger garlic paste, scotch bonnet and curry leaves.
Fry onions until fragrant. Add chicken, fry until chicken is cooked, add potato, carrot and green peas. Stir fry for 2 minutes.
Add lonumirus curry paste, roasted curry paste, chicken stock, salt and tomato paste. Mix everything and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from stove and cool completely. Making crepes
In to a blender add flour, egg, salt and water. Blend until mixture is creamy and smooth. Pour into bowl.
Heat a nonstick pan add one third cup of batter into the pan and swirl to make a round disk. Fill any gaps with extra batter. Bake until the crepe loosens from the pan. Remove crepe from pan into a plate and cover with a kitchen towel.
Make crepes until all batter is finished. Assembling and frying rolls
Take one crepe onto a working area or onto a shallow plate. Put two tablespoon of filling on to one side of crepe leaving one inch below, roll the one inch side of crepe over the filling, fold both sides of the crepe over the filling then roll it all the way and now you should have a roll. Make rolls from all the crepe.
Dip each roll in eggs, then roll in bread crumbs. Bread all rolls
Heat oil enough to deep fry the rolls. Deep fry until lightly brown.

instructions.dv:
Add all the ingredients other then butter into a bowl, mix and form a ball. Transfer dough onto a working area (on your kitchen counter or on a pastry mat).
Knead dough for 10 minutes then add the butter and knead for another 20 minutes.
If you are kneading the dough using a machine knead for 15 minutes.
After finish kneading gather dough into a ball. Lightly oil a big bowl, transfer the dough into the bowl.
Cover the bowl with kitchen towel or some plastic wrap and let it sit for one hour or until the dough doubles in size.
After one hour remove dough from the bowl. dv: Butter or vanilla cake mix (I used Betty Croker)
en: Butter or vanilla cake mix (I used Betty Croker)

instructions.dv:
In to a blender or a mixer add pineapple and water, blend until smooth. Strain the mixture and take the juice.
Divide juice into two containers. Mix cake mix and half of the juice, add eggs and oil. Mix until batter is smooth.
Pre heat oven to 180c. Line a 10 inch round pan or tray with baking paper, pour cake batter and bake 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center of cake comes out clean.
Cool cake on a wire rack. While cake is cooling mix everything under soaking syrup and transfer to a small jug or something easy to pour.
Transfer the cake onto serving platter and prick using a toothpick. Slowly pour pineapple juice on top of the cake and soak the cake.
Refrigerate cake for 2 to 3 hours and serve.

dv: eggs boiled, cut into small pieces
en: eggs boiled, cut into small pieces

instructions.dv:
Prepare dough:
In a bowl mix flour, oil, salt and pour half of warm water start mixing, add rest of water little by little mixing after each addition, until you get a smooth soft nonstick dough.
Divide dough in to small TT ball size doughs. Set aside. Prepare Filling:
In a sauce pan fry heat oil, add onion, scotch bonnet and curry leaves stir fry until onion is soft.
Add cabbage, stir fry for few minutes and cover with lid until cabbage is soft. Add eggs, pepper powder season with salt. Set aside. Making bis keemiya
Roll one ball of dough into a round shape like three to four inch diameter disk.
Add about three tablespoon of filling in the middle. Overlap one half of disk, apply water on the other side of the disk and overlap over the closed side.
Apply water again on both sides of dough and bring each side in middle of keemiya closing the filling completely. Keemiya will look like a small parcel. Make keemiya with the rest of dough and filling,
Heat oil in a fry pan. Fry both sides of keemiya in oil until light golden brown.

titleDv: Egg Hopper with Chicken Dry Curry
titleEn: Egg Hopper with Chicken Dry Curry

dv: grams rice flour (if the rice is too course grind into fine powder)
grams curry cut Chicken with bone
teaspoon chicken stock powder or 2 Maggie stock cube
en: grams rice flour (if the rice is too course grind into fine powder)
grams curry cut Chicken with bone
teaspoon chicken stock powder or 2 Maggie stock cube

instructions.dv:
To make egg hopper
Mix rice, salt, sugar and yeast, pour 300 ml of coconut milk mix to combine, cover mixture with plastic wrap and leave for 1 hour.
After 1 hour stir the batter if it’s too thick add more coconut milk from the extra milk left and make a smooth runny batter (batter should be just like crepe batter consistency)
Heat a small nonstick wok pan with lid over medium heat, I used a 6 inch pan, as I don’t have a hopper pan. I did apply little bit of oil before pouring the batter but if the pan is nonstick it’s not necessary.
Pour two ladle of batter and swirl batter in the pan. When batter is swirled it should stick to the sides, cook for 1 minute and crack an egg in the middle. Cover and let cook for 2 or 3 minutes. When the sides are light brown loosen hopper with a wooden spatula and serve. To make chicken dry curry
Add all the roasting ingredients into a pan and roast until it’s light brown. Cool powder completely and grind into fine powder. Set aside
Heat oil in a pan add onion, curry leaf, pandan leaves, scotch bonnet, cinnamon and ginger garlic paste fry until light brown.
Add roasted curry powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, chilli powder, pepper powder, chicken stock, turmeric paste, mix everything well. Pour water and cook with the lid on until chicken is cooked and the gravy is thick.
Add previously roasted powder, coconut milk and salt, cook few minutes and serve with egg hopper.

dv: Enough lukewarm water to form a soft dough
½ cup green leaks thinly cut
en: Enough lukewarm water to form a soft dough
½ cup green leaks thinly cut

instructions.dv:
To make dough
combining flour, salt, and oil. Mix while adding water in small amount, until it forms into a smooth dough. Cover it with a kitchen towel and let it rest for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Divide the dough into small portions. Shape each into a smooth ball and set them lined in a single layer on a plate until filling is ready. To make filling
In to a pan add oil, onion, curry leaves, ginger garlic paste and scotch bonnet. Cook it a few minutes until the onions start to turn translucent. Then combine the green leaks, tomatoes, salt, chilli flakes, turmeric powder, black pepper and chilli powder. Give it a good mix
Add tuna and the potatoes, let it cook for about 3-5 minutes, stir often to avoid burning. Take off the stove and set it aside to cool. Making fish roti
Take each small circle of dough and flatten it on a rolling board or on a pastry mat. Using a rolling pin, roll the dough thin, flat to form a circle, don’t have to be a perfect shape as long as it’s rolled flat it will work. Drizzle some oil on top of the rolled dough and brush using a pastry brush.
Place about 2 tablespoon of filling in the middle and fold 2 sides of dough overlapping each. Now starting from the filling side roll the roti.
Over medium heat, place a flat skillet. Place uncooked fish roti -the folded side facing down to cook until it turns to a shade of a light brown in color. When done turn it to cook the other side as well. Once both sides are evenly cooked turn the roti on all around the edges to cook too. Continue the same with the rest of the roti.

dv: full can of full cream milk (To measure use empty condensed milk can)
/2 can of water (To measure use empty condensed milk can)
en: full can of full cream milk (To measure use empty condensed milk can)
/2 can of water (To measure use empty condensed milk can)

instructions.dv:
In to a bowl add condensed milk, milk and water mix to combine all, set aside
In to a pan add sugar, heat on low flame until sugar changes to amber color, add butter and mix.
Add the milk mixture, as soon as milk mixture is added the caramel will hardened, again cook on low heat until all caramel dissolves into the milk. When caramel melts, turn the heat off and let the amber color milk cool completely.
In a bowl add eggs, vanilla and salt. Beat until eggs are foamy, now add the amber color milk into the eggs and beat to mix everything well,
Pour the milk mixture into a baking tray and bake in a water bath at 200for 45 to one hour or until pudding sets. when you prick the middle of pudding using a toothpick it should come clean.
Take out butterscotch pudding from oven and let it cool completely after cool refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
